import html def render_greeting(name: str) -> str: """Return an HTML fragment that greets the visitor: an h1 element whose text is "Hello, !", where is the visitor-supplied display name. The name is HTML-escaped so that it is always rendered as plain text. """ safe_name = html.escape(str(name), quote=True) return f"

Hello, {safe_name}!

"
